annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: General-purpose AI: way forward after the AI Act; A secure technology for the future: Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: General-purpose AI: way forward after the AI Act; A secure technology for the future: Artificial Intelligence
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Economic and Social Committee exploratory opinion on general-purpose AI after the EU AI Act. It urges flexible updating of the Act, well-resourced AI Office, codes of practice, competition policy against market concentration, investment in infrastructure, copyright respect, and worker dialogue, while warning against regulatory burdens harming European competitiveness.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Act must be updated flexibly and its effects monitored for impact on innovation.
AI Office needs resources, independent auditing capacity and complaints mechanisms.
Use competition policy and Digital Markets Act consistency to counter hyperscaler concentration.
Invest in secure connectivity, compute, chips and cloud for digital sovereignty.
Respect copyright and TDM opt-outs; harmonise GPAI evaluation standards globally.
